purpose: Keep repeated evidence observations in a ledger while GitHub issues represent one durable work owner per capability family.

EG-HOURLY-SEQUENCE.name: Hourly sequence and exact-anchor history
EG-HOURLY-SEQUENCE.scope: BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC timestamped price/return/flow sequences and exact nominal-horizon anchors.
EG-HOURLY-SEQUENCE.routing_rationale: One owner for missing or misaligned hourly market sequences.

EG-BREADTH-HISTORY.name: Comparable breadth history
EG-BREADTH-HISTORY.scope: Fixed/stable universe constituent continuity, advancers/decliners, return panels and persistence.
EG-BREADTH-HISTORY.routing_rationale: One owner for breadth continuity and comparable participation history.

EG-MARKET-STRUCTURE.name: Market structure and dominance history
EG-MARKET-STRUCTURE.scope: BTC dominance, Total2, Total3, aggregate capitalization and stablecoin-dominance context.
EG-MARKET-STRUCTURE.routing_rationale: One owner for aggregate market-structure and dominance context.

EG-ETF-FLOWS.name: Settled ETF flow history
EG-ETF-FLOWS.scope: Comparable settled BTC and ETH ETF net-flow history, persistence and transmission context.
EG-ETF-FLOWS.routing_rationale: One owner for settled ETF history and persistence.

EG-MACRO-HISTORY.name: Aligned macro history
EG-MACRO-HISTORY.scope: Rates, broad dollar, volatility and other approved macro observations aligned to crypto cutoffs.
EG-MACRO-HISTORY.routing_rationale: One owner for comparable macro history.

EG-STABLECOIN-LIQUIDITY.name: Stablecoin liquidity history
EG-STABLECOIN-LIQUIDITY.scope: Stablecoin supply, liquidity, composition, deployment and exchange-flow history.
EG-STABLECOIN-LIQUIDITY.routing_rationale: One owner for stablecoin liquidity history.

EG-DERIVATIVES-FORENSICS.name: Derivatives and microstructure forensics history
EG-DERIVATIVES-FORENSICS.scope: Funding, open interest, liquidations, taker/depth flow and options/skew history with venue and completeness metadata.
EG-DERIVATIVES-FORENSICS.routing_rationale: One owner for comparable derivatives and microstructure evidence.

EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES.name: Forecast candidate and outcome lineage
EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES.scope: Candidate issuance/freeze/cutoff, specifications, maturation, realized outcomes, benchmarks, containment and calibration.
EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES.routing_rationale: One owner for forecast/outcome auditability and matured scoring evidence.

EG-SENTIMENT.name: Sentiment and CFGI history
EG-SENTIMENT.scope: CFGI aggregate/component and other already-governed sentiment history needed for evaluation.
EG-SENTIMENT.routing_rationale: One owner for sentiment-history evidence gaps.

EG-PROVENANCE.name: Evidence provenance and existing-definition recovery
EG-PROVENANCE.scope: Frozen references, exact source bindings, existing settlement conventions and other authoritative-definition recovery.
EG-PROVENANCE.routing_rationale: One owner for provenance and existing-definition recovery gaps.

EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE.name: Unclassified evidence capability
EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE.scope: Fail-closed holding owner for genuinely new evidence capabilities until explicitly classified.
EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE.routing_rationale: Unknown evidence gaps remain one fail-closed owner instead of creating unbounded issues.
